map.📚 深度解析：建筑能耗指标: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Building Energy Use Index
map.能耗对标：录入面积与年单位能耗，对比节能标准（如 65% 节能）判断是否达标。: Benchmarking: enter the area and annual energy use per unit area and compare against efficiency standards (such as 65% energy saving) to judge compliance.
map.改造评估：对节能改造前后录入参数，量化节能量。: Retrofit assessment: enter parameters before and after an efficiency retrofit to quantify the savings.
map.教学演示：演示单位指标×面积得总能耗的线性关。: Teaching demo: show the linear relation between the unit index × area and total energy use.
map.示例：1 万 m² 建筑、单位能耗 80 kWh/m²·年，年能耗=800000: Example: a 10000 m² building with a unit energy use of 80 kWh/m²·year consumes 800000 kWh per year; lowering it to 50 saves 300000 kWh per year.
map.单位指标哪来？: Where does the unit index come from?
map.按建筑类型与气候区有能耗限额标准，也可用自身历史能耗反算。结果按公开标准与环境因: Energy consumption caps are set by building type and climate zone, and your own historical consumption can also be used to back-calculate it. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.和碳排放关系？: What is the relation to carbon emissions?
map.乘以电网因子得建筑运行碳排，是运行阶段主要排放来源。结果按公开标准与环境因子估算: Multiplying by the grid factor gives the building's operational carbon emissions, the main source during the operating phase. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.运行能耗易算；建材与施工(隐含碳)另计，全口径需含 embodied carbo: Operational energy is easy to account for; materials and construction (embodied carbon) are counted separately, so a full boundary must include embodied carbon. Results are estimated according to public standards and environmental factors, for science outreach, teaching and emission-reduction estimates; actual accounting should follow official guidelines (such as the GHG Protocol and provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.建筑能耗三指标：单位面积能耗 = 年用电量 ÷ 建筑面积（kWh/m²/年）；人: Three building energy metrics: energy intensity = annual electricity ÷ floor area (kWh/m²/year); per-capita energy = annual electricity ÷ occupants (kWh/person/year); carbon emissions per area = energy intensity × 0.5703 (kgCO₂/m², emission factor 0.5703 hardcoded). Validation: annual electricity, area, and occupants are guarded as non-empty valid numbers, with division by zero falling back to NaN. Criteria: no fixed grading; the larger the area or the occupant count, the lower the corresponding intensity metric.
